d: Short, swept-back platinum white hair with a sharp, wind-blown texture and a deep side part. Sharp, narrow golden eyes with an intense, focused expression on a face appearing in early adulthood with a mature, stern countenance. A slender yet athletic build wearing a layered outfit consisting of a light blue long coat with gold trim and buttons, a black waistcoat over a white collared shirt with a black tie, and a voluminous white cape with a deep red interior lining. Signature details include white gloves, gold-accented black footwear, and ornate gold metallic armor plating on the right shoulder and forearm.
